verdict.rationale: The public dor.wa.gov guidance page offers a by-mail route: complete 'the Business License Application, along with any additional forms' and mail it. That implies a paper form a founder can get, and the filing instructions sit on open dor.wa.gov pages, while only the My DOR transactional portal requires login. The evidence never states that the forms are downloadable PDFs reachable without an account. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloadable form files (e.g., PDF links), downloadable form-specific instructions, confirmation that no login is needed to download, coverage of tax-return forms beyond the license application, independent or hands-on corroboration.
